data.narrative:
Fid Labs is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $1.7M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe comprising one public comparable (277810.KQ) and eight private peers including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

The stage-progression method is the primary applicable approach, using the $1.7M raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement. This methodology yields an implied valuation of $4.25M. The peer-median approach could not be reliably applied due to insufficient comparable datapoints—while ten same-sector peers exist in robotics and manufacturing, the narrow filters (same stage, adjacent stage, similar valuation tier) returned fewer than three datapoints required for statistical confidence. Broadening to an all-sector median would introduce material bias.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $4.0M (low) to $5.0M (median $4.25M), with the relatively tight range reflecting reliance on a single method. Key uncertainties include the absence of robust peer comparables at the early-stage frontier-tech level and limited visibility into burn rate, runway, and product-market traction metrics. Any valuation within this range remains contingent on verification of operational milestones and market adoption trajectory post-seed.
